example.title: Keystone Ranch, sheep and hog barn

brief: Very long, low one-storey stock barn for sheep and hogs, about 36 ft wide and 180 ft long, of rough-coursed pale limestone with a plain gable end holding one narrow plank door and a tiny vent, a row of small square pen windows along the side. A shallow galvanized metal gable roof runs the whole length with a line of small round metal ridge vents, and a horse-and-rider weathervane on a rod over the gable. A dry-laid stone corral wall juts out from the side; gravel ranch lane and short prairie grass in front. (Long livestock shed barn; nearest vocabulary type is english_three_bay.)
